ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a digital circuit, with two in-series inverters (NOT gates) at the top, each inverter symbol having a small circle at the output terminal. The output of the first inverter is connected to the input of the second inverter, and the output of the second inverter is again looped back through an outer wire to the input of the first inverter, forming a closed feedback loop. Reasoning: The question asks what kind of multivibrator this digital circuit composed of two inverters with feedback will behave as. There are two inversions in total in the loop, so the total feedback is positive feedback; it will not form an odd-numbered-inverter ring oscillator, but can remain in one of two stable states. Therefore, this circuit functions as a bistable multivibrator.
